lines.cap: Never say I wish to a genie. Here's why.
lines.say: Never say I wish to a genie. Here's why.

lines.cap: He rubs an old lamp. Out comes a genie.
lines.say: He rubs an old lamp. Out comes a genie.

lines.cap: Rich, you said? Done! Enjoy being a coin!
lines.say: Rich, you said? Done! Enjoy being a coin!

lines.cap: He is now a coin. A two rupee coin.
lines.say: He is now a coin. A two rupee coin.

lines.cap: I wish I was human again!
lines.say: I wish I was human again!
lines.bubble: I WISH I WAS HUMAN AGAIN! 😱

lines.cap: He's human again. Two centimetres tall.
lines.say: He's human again. Two centimetres tall.

lines.cap: I wish I was normal size, and rich, and...
lines.say: I wish I was normal size, and rich, and...

lines.cap: Ah ah ah. That's four wishes. Page one of the rules.
lines.say: Ah ah ah. That's four wishes. Page one of the rules.

lines.cap: The rule book is forty pages long.
lines.say: The rule book is forty pages long.

lines.cap: He has one wish left. He's still on page two.
lines.say: He has one wish left. He's still on page two.

lines.cap: Tag the friend who'd waste all three. Never say I wish to a genie.
lines.say: Tag the friend who'd waste all three. Never say I wish to a genie.
